messages.subject: Trace plot does not change
parts:
Hi all,

I have obtained a strange trace plot (attached figure). To me that is strange because the trace does not fluctuate as usual trace plots. I do not understand stan behind the scene so I cannot not explain why the plot does not explore the parameter space.

Does anyone has idea?

Thank you,

Tran.

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: Trace plot does not change
parts:
Hi!

The problem is the scale of the plot. You should redo the plot with the window=100 or so option turned on. Then the first 100 iterations will be discarded and you will get a zoomed in plot.

Sebastian

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Trace plot does not change
parts:
Sebastian's right that it's the scale. The dispersed starting values require a pretty large scale on the y-axis but post-warmup it then just looks like a line. If you set inc_warmup=FALSE it will only show post-warmup and it should automatically adjust the scale to a more reasonable one. 

Jonah

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: Trace plot does not change
parts:
Hi!

Looks like Stan is not warming up right for those odd looking chains. You may want to control initialization a bit more. That means to provide better initials, i.e. use your prior knowledge to start the chains in a more sensible region. Also start with non-random initials and then go to random initials which vary by chain.

However, if this is just an "intermediate" model which you build for exploration purposes - then I would not bother too much with this as I would not expect that things change; but this is not a super-clean MCMC run, that's obvious.

Sebastian
